nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Chuyện vặt hằng ngày · bài tự soạn
L: A
Ken, I'm so sorry. I'm stuck in traffic on Maple Road.
B
Again? What's going on? It's not even rush hour.
A
There's roadwork near the bridge. Everything is bumper to bumper.
B
Ugh, that's the worst. Can you take the back road instead?
A
I'd love to, but I don't know the way. My map says it clears up after the bridge.
B
Okay, then just sit tight. How long do you think it'll take?
A
Maybe fifteen minutes. I'll let you know when I'm moving again.
B
No rush. We haven't started the grill at the park yet anyway.
A
Thanks! Oh, finally, the cars are starting to move!
B
Great. Drive safe, and keep your eyes on the road!

exq.why: “I'm stuck in traffic on Maple Road” = đang kẹt xe.

exq.q: What is causing the traffic jam?
exq.why: “There's roadwork near the bridge” = gần cầu đang sửa đường.

exq.q: How long does Mai think it will take?
exq.why: “Maybe fifteen minutes” = chắc mười lăm phút.

exq.q: What does Ken tell Mai at the end?
exq.a: Drive safely and watch the road
exq.why: “Drive safe, and keep your eyes on the road” = lái xe cẩn thận, nhìn đường.
